description.en: Plugins maintained by Luca-42 for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: Luca-42 维护的 DeepSeek Harness 插件。

description.en: Drive a local Saber-Translator manga translator through its HTTP API: shelf, pages, translation jobs, job control, page images, glossary, backend lifecycle. Works with Saber 3.5+ (/api/v2) and degrades gracefully on 3.3.x.
description.zh: 用自然语言驱动本机 Saber-Translator 漫画翻译器：书架、页面、翻译任务、任务控制、页面图片、术语表、后端启停。支持 Saber 3.5+（/api/v2），3.3.x 自动降级。
